A 53-year-old man with hypertension seeks medical attention for neck pain. He has recently started
taking atorvastatin 10 mg daily for newly diagnosed hypercholesterolemia and reports sleep
disturbances due to neck discomfort. During the osteopathic structural examination, you observe
restricted right lateral flexion and left rotation of the neck. There is muscle hypertonicity in the left lateral
neck region between the mastoid process and clavicle. What is the correct initial positioning for muscle
energy technique in this case? Answer Choices: (A) Flex, side bend the cervical neck to the right and
rotate the cervical neck to the right (B) Extend, side bend the cervical neck to the left and rotate the
cervical neck to the right (C) Extend, side bend the cervical neck to the right and rotate the cervical
neck to the left (D) Neutral, side bend the cervical neck to the right and rotate the cervical neck to the
left (E) Flex, side bend the cervical neck to the right and rotate the cervical neck to the left (F) Neutral,
side bend the cervical neck to the left and rotate the cervical neck to the right (G) Extend, side bend the
cervical neck to the right and rotate the cervical neck to the right (H) Extend, side bend the cervical
neck to the left and rotate the cervical neck to the left (I) Flex, side bend and rotate the cervical neck to
the left (J) Flex, side bend the cervical neck to the left and rotate the cervical neck to the left
 A. Extend, side bend the cervical neck to the right and rotate the cervical neck to the left
B. Flex, side bend and rotate the cervical neck to the left
C. Extend, side bend the cervical neck to the left and rotate the cervical neck to the left
D. Neutral, side bend the cervical neck to the right and rotate the cervical neck to the left
E. Extend, side bend the cervical neck to the right and rotate the cervical neck to the right
F. Flex, side bend the cervical neck to the right and rotate the cervical neck to the right
G. Neutral, side bend the cervical neck to the left and rotate the cervical neck to the right
H. Flex, side bend the cervical neck to the left and rotate the cervical neck to the left
I. Flex, side bend the cervical neck to the right and rotate the cervical neck to the left
J. Extend, side bend the cervical neck to the left and rotate the cervical neck to the right
